description: Tag Pilot SEO check over one period, by query (default) or page. low_ctr: rows on page one (avg position ≤ 10) with plenty of impressions but a CTR under half of a typical CTR for that position, so the title/snippet likely underperforms. striking_distance: rows ranking around positions 5–20 (configurable) with enough impressions, where a small ranking gain pays off. "Typical CTR" is a rough industry benchmark curve, not Google data. Search Console data typically lags 2–3 days; the default range ends 3 days ago (Pacific Time). Pass data_state "all" to include fresher, still-changing data. Grouping or filtering by query omits anonymised (rare) queries, so query rows add up to less than the totals by date, country or device.

expression.description: Value to match. country: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3, lowercase (e.g. "pol", "usa"); device: "DESKTOP", "MOBILE" or "TABLET"; page: a full URL.

operator.description: Default "equals". Regex operators use RE2 syntax.

max_position.description: Striking distance up to this average position. Default 20.

min_impressions.description: Ignore rows with fewer impressions. Default 100.

min_position.description: Striking distance from this average position. Default 5.

rows_to_scan.description: How many rows (sorted by clicks) to fetch per period. Default 5,000, max 25,000. Rows beyond this are not considered.

search_type.description: Default "web". "discover" and "googleNews" don't support grouping by query or aggregation_type "byProperty".

site_url.description: Search Console property exactly as list_sites shows it: "sc-domain:example.com" for a domain property, or a URL prefix with its trailing slash, e.g. "https://www.example.com/".
